text: Changed local session transcripts to also record each API request's system prompt
Changed `UserPromptSubmit` hooks to run before a skill or custom slash command expands
Added idle compaction in the terminal
Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks
Fixed PowerShell commands not seeing variables that hooks write to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE
Fixed variables a SessionStart hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool
Fixed plan mode running a write (an MCP tool's, a file's, a shell command's)
Changed MCP allow rules to reach only the server they name
`updatedInput` from PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks is now validated
Fixed scheduled tasks and loops firing again after every turn, or firing early, during the repeated hour
Fixed `$.ui.open` reporting a mod's pane as placed
